lines.en: My little leg bones run very fast.
Light bones rattle as I run.

lines.zh: 我追着大个子的脚印走。
lines.en: I follow the big one's footprints.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我一步顶两步。
lines.en: Small as I am, one step covers two.

lines.zh: 落叶在我脚下碎成一片响。
lines.en: Leaves shatter into noise under my feet.
My kneecap is loose, but I can still run.
I walk at the very back of the group.
Wait for me up ahead.
I slip through cracks in the stone.
My bones are thin, so I wobble when I walk.

lines.zh: 我小跑着，绕开每一块石头。
lines.en: I trot along, dodging every stone.

lines.zh: 谁掉了一根骨头，是我的。
lines.en: Someone dropped a bone. Mine now.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来数自己的肋骨。
lines.en: I squat down and count my ribs.
The wind blows, and my joints creak.
I am waiting for the big one to call me.
This helmet is too big and keeps sliding.
I straighten each finger bone.

lines.zh: 没事做，我敲敲自己的头骨。
lines.en: With nothing to do, I tap my skull.

lines.zh: 我盯着地上的蚂蚁发呆。
lines.en: I stare at ants on the ground.
Will this body ever grow?

lines.zh: 我试着吹口哨，没有嘴唇。
lines.en: I try to whistle, but I have no lips.
The quiet makes me want to find someone.
You tower over me by a head or three.

lines.zh: 你低头，我抬头，正好对上。
lines.en: You look down; I look up. We meet.
That sword in your hand is huge.

lines.zh: 你的靴子能装下我半个身子。
lines.en: Your boot could hold half of me.

lines.zh: 你在笑我这副小骨架吗。
lines.en: Is that a laugh at my small bones?
I know the smell of iron on you.
Hold still. I am studying your knees.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比我整颗头还亮。
lines.en: Your eyes are brighter than my whole skull.
Are you here for bones too?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，因为你先盯我。
lines.en: I stare back because you started staring.
Two of my ribs snapped.
A bone cracked, but nothing bleeds.
I fell apart and am putting myself together.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我头骨发响。
lines.en: That blow set my skull ringing.

lines.zh: 关节最脆，你偏往那儿打。
lines.en: The joints are weakest, and you aim there.
I pick up the broken bone and press it back.
It hurts, but not the way flesh hurts.
My leg bones hold. Do not laugh yet.
Bone dust is scattered everywhere.
Break me apart. I will piece myself back.

lines.zh: 把你手里那根骨头递过来。
lines.en: Hand over that bone you are holding.
I do not want bread. I want bone.
It smells like an old grave.
Wave a bone, and I will follow.
This one is too fresh. I do not like it.
Give me one, and I will not bite.
My teeth cannot handle hard things.

lines.zh: 你藏起来的骨头，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the bone you hid.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，骨头才有。
lines.en: Food is useless to me. Bones matter.

lines.zh: 你把骨头丢远点，我去捡。
lines.en: Throw the bone farther. I will fetch it.
You knocked me into a pile.

lines.zh: 我轻得很，被碰一下就滑开。
lines.en: I am so light that a touch slides me back.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛骨卡在你腿边。
lines.en: My shoulder blade is stuck against your leg.
Let me by. I need that gap.

lines.zh: 你靴底压住我的脚骨了。
lines.en: Your boot came down on my foot bone.
I pick up the finger bone I dropped.
A bump does not hurt. It just scatters me.
You have to look down to see me.
I duck through the gap between your legs.
Do not shove me. My bones will misalign.

lines.zh: 我骨架还小，谈不了这个。
lines.en: My frame is still small for that talk.

lines.zh: 配对的事，等我长高再说。
lines.en: Pairing? Ask me when I am taller.
What mate would a skeleton have?
The big one says I am too young.
I do not want a nest of little bones.
That question makes me awkward.
My bones are not all grown in.
Talk to me when I am a big skeleton.
My kin are all lying in the dirt.
Do not pair me off at random.
I saw that bone first.
I pick it up and tuck it between my ribs.
Dropped things? I can carry those.
I will hide this coin in my skull.
You dropped an arrow. I took it.

lines.zh: 我抱着一堆骨头走不快。
lines.en: Carrying a pile of bones slows me down.
Do not snatch it. I have been collecting.

lines.zh: 我蹲下捡，膝盖响了一声。
lines.en: I crouch to pick it up, and my knee clicks.
A bone shard on the ground. Mine.
I am better at collecting than fighting.
Living thing spotted. I will fetch the others.
Big one, there is a target here.
I go first; you follow.
I see his boots.
Footsteps on stone. Very loud.
His back is turned to us.
The target is big. I cannot win alone.
I will keep him in sight. Hurry.

lines.zh: 这个人身上的铁味很重。
lines.en: This one smells strongly of iron.
My bones are trembling with excitement.
He is coming down the slope.
I will circle around behind him.
Do not let him run. Block the path.
The small one starts; the big one finishes.

lines.zh: 有人点火了，我叫大个子来。
lines.en: Someone lit a torch; I call the big one.
He ran left. Chase.
My legs are fast. I will bite first.

lines.zh: 他爬上石头了，我跳不上去。
lines.en: He climbed a rock. I cannot jump that high.
I snap at his heels.
He swung. Duck low.
I hide in a crack and wait.
He is panting. We close in.
On three, we all go.
Not the armor. Bite the joints.
He is looking away. Good chance.
I trip him; you finish.

lines.zh: 他被逼到墙角，没路可走。
lines.en: He is cornered now, with nowhere left.
I circle him until he is dizzy.
Bones, hold together. I still have chasing to do.
He runs forward; I follow behind.
He chops wood; I wait for him to tire.

lines.zh: 我数他喘息，第三下就上。
lines.en: I count his gasps; on the third I go.

lines.zh: 他弯腰捡东西，那就是破绽。
lines.en: He bends to pick something up. That is the gap.
Bit him. His skin is soft.
My bite is light, but it annoys.
He kicked me, and half of me scattered.
I grab his ankle.
My tooth chipped. I still bite.
His armor is hard. Try elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我撞他膝盖，让他弯下去。
lines.en: I ram his knee to bend him down.
That will distract him.

lines.zh: 我爬到他背上咬着不放。
lines.en: I climb his back and hold on.
He flung me off.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉的手骨，继续上。
lines.en: I grab my fallen hand and go again.
Bite his fingers so he drops the sword.
Small as I am, my bite lands true.

lines.zh: 大个子快来，我撑不住了。
lines.en: Big one, hurry. I cannot hold.

lines.zh: 我咬住他的皮带，往后拉。
lines.en: I bite his belt and pull backwards.

lines.zh: 我拿头撞他小腿，撞得挺响。
lines.en: I butt his shin, and it makes a good noise.
I clawed my way out of the dirt.
New bones, freshly assembled.
This stretch of underground is ours.
I woke before the big one.
The cave echoes so loudly.
Who left my bones under this dirt?
I stand, and my knees click first.
A pack of little skeletons, born in a crowd.
There is light above. I want to see it.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的骨头是白的。
lines.en: In the dark, my bones are white.

lines.zh: 我从窄石缝里挤出来，个头很小。
lines.en: I squeeze from a narrow crack, tiny and new.

lines.zh: 今天开始，我跟着大个子混。
lines.en: Starting today, I run with the big one.
The bones are joined. I am out.
Do not step on me. I just found my feet.

lines.zh: 火烧得我的骨头噼啪响。
lines.en: Fire makes my bones crackle.
I fell, and my foot bone bent.
Water washed one finger bone away.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹成一堆骨头。
lines.en: The blast blew me into a bone pile.
The arrow went between my ribs.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的骨头抖个不停。
lines.en: Magic makes my bones shake.
I need no food, so I cannot starve.
Lightning burned me white.

lines.zh: 下面太黑，我的骨头都看不见。
lines.en: Too dark below to see my own bones.
